svg.text: Writes 8 GiB of test data to / (free: 292.9 GiB), reads it back,
then deletes it. Existing files are not touched, but the filesystem is
nearly full while the test runs, and on a counterfeit drive writes past
its real capacity can damage existing data — back up first.
It also overwrites the free space, so files deleted earlier can no longer
be recovered — do not run it while you still want to undelete something.
Note: only a full-size run can prove the whole capacity.
first 8 GiB — minutes; proves only that part
FULL not offered: system disk (/ is on it) — use the CLI with --full
